description: Meet Audrey P. Willis, candidate for Arkansas State Representative for District 35. A proven leader in technology, education, and innovation, Audrey has dedicated her career to empowering communities across West Memphis, Marion, Earle, Parkin, and Turrell. From co-founding CodeCrew to serving as Chief Innovation and Strategy Officer, Audrey’s mission is to create jobs, strengthen education, and build an Arkansas where every family can thrive and succeed.
title: MEET AUDREY | Audrey for Arkansas District 35
